issues.description: getCategoryLabel heuristic silently regresses labels the explicit map handled correctly.
issues.detail: The old CATEGORY_LABELS map produced 'Trust Boundaries', 'Forensics Ready', etc. The new heuristic (length<=3 uppercase, version regex) yields 'Trustboundaries' and is correct only by coincidence for IAM/E3/E5. This silently weakens the postcondition. Restore the authoritative ID->label map and use heuristics only as fallback.

issues.description: SEVERITY_ORDER invariant broken by duplicate ordinal 4 for both 'Info' and 'Informational'.
issues.detail: Adding Info: 4 alongside Informational: 4 papers over an upstream API inconsistency and breaks the bijection from severity name to rank. Code that inverts, iterates, or sorts will be ambiguous. Canonicalize ('Info' -> 'Informational') at the API boundary instead of duplicating the key in the shared constant.

issues.description: CategoryId type union deleted, weakening the compile-time contract for categories.
issues.detail: The previous module exported CategoryId as a discriminated union of known IDs, giving callers a typed enumeration. Replacing it with a bare string->string function loses any subtype discipline; callers now accept arbitrary strings. Restore the typed contract or document the new boundary explicitly.

issues.description: Unrelated 'Threat Score' -> 'Prowler ThreatScore' rename should be split from the Risk Radar PR.
issues.detail: The PR title scopes this change to Risk Radar with category filtering, but the diff also renames terminology in risk-plot-client.tsx and threat-score.tsx. That is a separate concern (copy, i18n, backend string consistency) with its own review surface. Split into a dedicated patch.

issues.description: CategorySelector uses 'all' as null-sentinel, colliding with the category id value domain.
issues.detail: handleValueChange treats '' or 'all' as clear-selection. Categories come from the API; if a category id 'all' ever ships, selecting it silently clears state. Use an explicit non-colliding sentinel constant or a separate clear control instead of overloading a value-domain string.

issues.description: HorizontalBarChart overloads item.percentage with two semantics and recomputes maxValue per item.
issues.detail: The 'percentage' field is used both as width-relative-to-max and as value/total*100, making the contract ambiguous; split into widthRatio and sharePercent. Separately, Math.max(...data.map(...)) is invoked inside the .map loop rather than hoisted, repeating per item.

synthesis.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The Risk Radar component itself is acceptable, but the surrounding patch regresses contracts and bundles unrelated changes. The most serious issue is replacing the explicit CATEGORY_LABELS map with heuristics that silently mislabel real IDs like 'trustboundaries'. SEVERITY_ORDER's bijection is broken by duplicating ordinal 4 across 'Info' and 'Informational' instead of normalizing at the API boundary, and the CategoryId type union was deleted without replacement. Split the unrelated 'Prowler ThreatScore' rename into its own patch, restore the authoritative label map and typed contract, and tighten the smaller boundary issues before landing.
